Madoka Asahina (Japanese: 朝日奈丸佳 Asahina Madoka) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Asahina was born on December 17, 1993 in , , and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined during , voicing Team Skull member Rapp, one of her best-known roles to date. Asahina is currently affiliated with the talent agency .
